summary: Frontend E2E verified: (1) Posting page Edit Payment modal opens via posting-edit-{unit}, saves changes (amount 321, date 2026-01-05, method zelle, notes) and persists after reload — re-opening the same row shows the saved values. (2) Fees page regression: EditFeeModal still opens correctly from edit-fee-{unit}. (3) Delinquency page loads without errors; in the current state there are 0 delinquent rows so remind-all-btn is correctly hidden and delinquency-empty state is shown — this is the documented acceptable behavior. Could not exercise the actual 428 remind-all path because no delinquent rows exist in the seed data at the moment of testing.
critical_code_review_comments: EditFeeModal is well-extracted and shared cleanly between Posting.jsx and Fees.jsx.
Delinquency.remind-all flow gracefully surfaces backend error via toast (e.response.data.detail) — acceptable UX for 428.
Posting.jsx: markPaid + edit modal share the same PUT /fees/{id} endpoint — no duplication concerns.
seed_data_creation: Modified fee row for unit 601 for Jan 2026 (marked paid, $321.00, 2026-01-05, zelle, note 'automated test note') as part of Posting edit verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delinquency currently has zero past-due rows because all fees are current, so remind-all-btn is hidden. To exercise the 428 error toast path, first create a delinquent fee (e.g., mark an older month unpaid) then reload /delinquency and click remind-all-btn; expect toast.error and network POST /api/reports/delinquency/remind-all returning 428.
